find_adsorbate_binding_sites: run adsorbate binding site search on a bulk material surface using the OCP API with a specified model
get_adsorbate_slab_relaxation_results: fetch relaxation results for adsorbate slab configurations by system ID from the OCP API
wait_for_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: poll and wait for all adsorbate slab relaxations in a system to finish with progress tracking
Lifetime_enum: use the Lifetime enum to choose whether relaxations should be saved, marked ephemeral, or deleted after fetching
AdsorbateBindingSites_dataclass: review the AdsorbateBindingSites dataclass to inspect adsorbate, bulk, model, and slab relaxation results
